question: How do I book a test?
shortLabel: How do I book a test?
keywords: how do i book a test
answer:
To book a test:
1. Select the product category.
2. Choose the required test package or individual parameters.
3. Enter sample and contact details.
4. Select sample collection or self-submission option.
5. Review your order and complete the payment.
6. You will receive an order confirmation and tracking ID.

question: What can I test?
answer:
You can test a wide range of samples, including:
• Food and beverage products
• Raw materials and ingredients
• Dairy products
• Meat, fish and poultry products
• Bakery and confectionery products
• Fruits and vegetables
• Oils and fats
• Water and ice samples

To know more, you can get in touch with our technical support.

question: How much sample is required?
answer:
The required sample quantity depends on the product type and selected tests. Typical requirements are:
• Solid foods: 200–500 g
• Liquid samples: 250–500 ml
• Water samples: 500 ml–1 litre
• Swab samples: As per collection kit instructions

The exact sample quantity will be displayed during test selection and booking.

question: Track my sample
answer:
You can track your sample in the **My Orders** section of the app.

You will also receive notifications at important stages.

question: When will I get my report?
shortLabel: When will I get my report?
keywords: when will i get my report
answer:
Report timelines depend on the selected tests and sample type.

Typical turnaround times:
• Basic tests: 5-7 working days
• Microbiological tests: 5-7 working days
• Nutritional analysis: 7–10 working days
• Specialised tests: As communicated during booking

You can check the expected timeline in your order details and track the status in the app.

question: Talk to Support
answer:
You can connect with us through:

Please keep your Order ID ready for faster assistance.
